key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10320
name: poll_text_field_input
description: Loops polling the input port for events: a click chooses one of eight entries, and typed characters fill a line of up to fifteen characters. Backspace removes a character, return commits the line, and a bar cursor character is toggled on each cursor event while editing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10328
name: resume_text_field_input
description: Variant of the text field input loop entered at its selection-click branch, which records the chosen entry, redraws it and resumes polling. Backspace, return and printable-character handling are otherwise the same as the main loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1034E
name: draw_entry_and_poll_input
description: Input loop variant that, when it exits, draws the currently selected entry's label and frame before returning. It shares the event handling of the text field loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10390
name: poll_text_field_input_alt
description: Copy of the text field input loop with its entry-selection path reordered; it polls events, dispatches on the event class, and handles printable keys, backspace and return in the same way.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10394
name: redraw_entry_and_poll_input
description: Text field input loop entered after redrawing the current entry: it draws the selected entry's text through library text calls, then keeps polling events for typed characters and clicks.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:103DE
name: poll_list_selection_input
description: Event loop over eight list entries that tracks the selected index, redraws the entry that changed, and accepts typed characters and backspace for the entry text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:103FC
name: poll_list_selection_redraw
description: Event loop that redraws the previously selected list entry and draws the newly clicked one when the click lands on a different entry, then keeps polling until the exit event.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1042C
name: dispatch_text_field_event
description: Takes the event class in a register and dispatches it: a click selects an entry, a key class edits the text buffer, backspace and return are handled, and other classes are ignored. It returns when the selected index is nine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10462
name: poll_list_input_and_exit
description: Input polling loop over eight list entries that exits by redrawing the final selection once an entry is chosen; typed characters are otherwise appended to the field text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:104EC
name: forward_call_then_return
description: Trivial wrapper that calls one routine with no arguments and then returns; it does no work of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:104F8
name: copy_text_return_length
description: Copies a string into a destination buffer through a library text call with a fixed mode flag, writes a space after the copied text, and returns the length reported by the other routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10540
name: check_printable_ascii_char
description: Returns one when the low word of its argument lies in the printable ASCII range from space to tilde, and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1055E
name: build_active_entry_table
description: Clears a table of eight sixteen-byte records, then copies the name of each list entry whose flag is set into the table in order, stores each entry's index in the record's last byte, and saves the count of active entries in a global.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1057E
name: build_active_entry_table_regs
description: Same table build as its neighbour, using register-held loop counters and pointers: it clears eight records, copies the active entries and writes the active count to a global.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1059A
name: build_active_entry_table_loop
description: Single-loop variant of the active entry table build: it walks the eight entries, copies each flagged entry into the table with its index, and stores the number of copied records in a global.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:105F4
name: draw_entry_list_panel
description: Draws a title string and then eight rows of entry text in a loop with the colour set for each row, then draws a marker after the second string, positioned by that string's length clamped to nine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1074C
name: draw_dialog_frame_rectangles
description: Sets the draw colour and draws two rectangles: a frame anchored at the top-left corner and a larger rectangle offset from it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1079E
name: draw_button_images_flagged
description: Sets the draw colour and draws four stored graphic items in sequence, skipping the third when the flag argument is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10806
name: draw_cancel_done_buttons
description: Clears the area, always draws the Cancel label at a fixed position, and draws the Done label first only when the flag argument is nonzero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:108A2
name: draw_rectangle_outline
description: Builds a five-point closed outline from four coordinate values in an array, moves to the first corner, and draws the outline through the library.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1091A
name: open_window_or_report_error
description: Opens a window from a prepared window description through a library call and stores its handle; when opening fails it reports the unable-to-open-a-window message through an error routine and returns false.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10948
name: return_one
description: Returns the constant one to its caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10966
name: close_window_and_clear_handle
description: If a window handle is held, closes it through a library call, makes a second library call with two fixed arguments, and clears the stored handle; it then calls a cleanup routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1099C
name: load_fixed_resource_or_fail
description: Prepares a 32-byte scratch buffer and looks up a resource by a fixed identifier. When it is found, it runs a library operation with a fixed size argument and calls a cleanup routine on the handle; otherwise it makes a library call with a fixed flag. It returns whether the resource was found.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:109D6
name: call_routine_then_return_one
description: Calls a library routine with no arguments, then another routine, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:109F4
name: load_resource_with_optional_init
description: Prepares a 32-byte scratch buffer, calls another routine first when the stored flag is zero, then looks up a second fixed resource. When it is found, it runs the same library operation and cleanup as the other loader, and returns whether it was found.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10A26
name: call_two_routines_return_one
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10A44
name: build_saves_path_string
description: Clears the first byte of a buffer. When the stored flag is zero it first copies a colon-terminated form of the ChessSaves text into the buffer and calls another routine; it then copies the ChessSaves text into the buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10A90
name: initialize_struct_and_call_routine
description: Fills a record pointed to by its first argument with zeros and a constant type byte, stores a global base value and the third argument in it, then passes the record and the second argument to another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10AE4
name: setup_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Registers an interrupt handler through a library call and stores its result, resets the serial receive ring buffer's read and write positions to its start, then writes three hardware values: two to the interrupt request and enable registers and one to the serial period register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10B26
name: send_serial_bytes_blocking
description: Sends a sequence of bytes through the serial data register, setting an extra high bit on each byte and waiting for the transmit buffer to be empty before each send.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10B4A
name: send_serial_bytes_write_first
description: Sends a byte sequence through the serial data register like its neighbour, but writes each byte first and only then waits for the transmit buffer to be empty, stopping right after the last byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10B5E
name: stub_empty_return
description: Empty routine that only returns; it has no work and no effect.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10B66
name: receive_serial_bytes_with_timeout
description: Reads the requested number of bytes from the serial receive ring buffer into a destination, waiting on a timer-based timeout for data. It returns zero on success and minus one when a wait times out.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10BB0
name: receive_serial_bytes_copy_first
description: Copies bytes from the serial receive ring buffer into a destination, taking the first byte before waiting on a timeout for each further byte. It returns minus one when a wait times out and zero when the requested count is reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10BDE
name: return_negative_one
description: Returns the constant minus one to its caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10BE8
name: receive_serial_bytes_wait_first
description: Receive loop that checks the remaining count first, then waits on a timeout for data and copies each byte from the serial receive ring buffer. It returns minus one on timeout and zero once the count is used up.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10BEA
name: return_zero
description: Returns the constant zero to its caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10BEE
name: clear_serial_receive_buffer
description: Empties the serial receive ring buffer by setting its read position equal to its write position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10BFC
name: count_serial_receive_bytes
description: Returns the number of bytes waiting in the serial receive ring buffer, computed from the write and read positions and wrapping around the buffer's 128-byte size.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10C1E
name: measure_ring_buffer_offset
description: Computes the distance from a position held in a local variable to the ring buffer's read position, wrapping by the buffer's 128 bytes, stores it in a local and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10C36
name: disable_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Writes a clear-enable value to the interrupt enable register to switch off the serial receive interrupt, then removes the handler for interrupt eleven through a library call using the stored handle.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10C54
name: store_byte_in_ring_buffer
description: Stores one byte from a message field at the ring buffer's write position, advances the position and wraps it after the end of the 128-byte buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10C7E
name: send_message_with_checksum_retry
description: Computes a two-accumulator checksum over the message bytes and sends the message with its checksum, then reads replies: a timeout sends a failure code and clears the message, a retry reply resends it, and an unexpected reply reports a sending-collision message and stops. After five attempts it reports that the opponent is not responding.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10CAC
name: send_checksummed_message_loop
description: Variant of the checksummed send that sums the message bytes into two alternating accumulators, sends the message and checksum, and resends on a retry reply. An unexpected reply byte reports the sending-collision message, and five attempts without a valid reply report that the opponent is not responding.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10D08
name: await_packet_ack_retry
description: Handles the reply phase of the link protocol: a retry reply sends the response again, an unexpected byte reports an error and returns, and a timeout sends a failure code and clears the byte. Five attempts without a valid reply report that the opponent is not responding.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10D2C
name: await_reply_or_report_collision
description: Waits for a reply through up to five attempts: a timeout sends a failure code and clears the reply, a retry reply sends the message again, and a first unexpected byte reports the sending-collision message and stops. Five attempts without a reply report that the opponent is not responding.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10D4C
name: await_reply_with_timeouts
description: Waits for a reply through up to five attempts: each timeout sends a failure code and clears the reply byte, and an unexpected reply reports the sending-collision message and stops. If no acceptable reply arrives within five attempts it reports that the opponent is not responding.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10DBA
name: dispatch_incoming_link_packet
description: Reads the next incoming link packet and dispatches it: a packet of the expected type family is length-limited and checksum-verified before its acknowledgement or state flag is applied, and text lines are read up to a return character and reported unless they are the expected ATE string. It returns minus one when processing ends without success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10E42
name: verify_link_packet_and_ack
description: Verifies a link packet by summing its bytes into two alternating accumulators and comparing them with the trailing checksum. On a match it sends the acknowledgement code for the first packet type or sets a state flag for the second; unexpected bytes are reported, and it returns minus one when no valid packet arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10E72
name: run_link_handshake_loop
description: Sets a handshake flag and loops over received packets: a verified first-type packet sends the acknowledgement code chosen by a state flag, a second-type packet keeps the loop running, any other type returns zero, and a failed packet returns minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10E7A
name: send_ack_then_await_packet
description: Sends the acknowledgement code chosen by a state flag, then receives packets: a verified first-type packet ends the wait, an unexpected type returns zero, and a failed or timed-out packet returns minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10E88
name: send_ack_and_retry_link
description: Sends the first acknowledgement code, then receives packets; if a state flag is set afterwards it sends the second acknowledgement code and repeats, stopping once the flag is clear.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10EA2
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns the constant zero without doing anything else.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10EAC
name: handle_link_packet_type
description: Takes the packet type in a register: the first type sends the acknowledgement code chosen by a state flag, the second type sets the flag, and any other type returns zero. It then receives and checksums the following packet and returns minus one if that fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10EBA
name: receive_link_packet_ack_loop
description: Receives checksummed link packets: a first-type packet triggers the acknowledgement code chosen by a state flag, a second-type packet keeps the loop running, and other types return zero. A failed packet returns minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10EC6
name: start_link_handshake_loop
description: Calls another routine, sets a state flag, then loops over received packets: a verified first-type packet sends the acknowledgement code chosen by the flag, a second-type packet sets the flag again, other types return zero, and a failed packet returns minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10ED2
name: receive_checked_link_packet
description: Reads a length-prefixed packet of at most forty bytes and verifies its two-accumulator checksum: a matching first-type packet sends the acknowledgement code and a second-type packet sets a state flag. It returns minus one when the length is too large or a read fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10EDA
name: parse_link_text_or_packet
description: Reads incoming link data: a text line is read up to a return character and reported unless it is the expected ATE string, while a packet of the expected type family is length- and checksum-checked before its acknowledgement or state flag is applied. It returns minus one when data stops arriving.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10F12
name: read_link_text_or_packet
description: Clears the destination byte, reports any text line other than the expected ATE string, then receives packets: type-family packets are length- and checksum-checked and answered, and newline-terminated text is read up to a return character. It returns minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10F4C
name: poll_link_packets_and_text
description: Sets a state flag after another routine call and loops over received data: packets of the expected type family are length- and checksum-checked and answered, while text lines are read up to a return character and reported unless they are the expected ATE string. It returns minus one when data stops arriving.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10F62
name: send_status_packet_conditionally
description: If either of two status words equals two, clears a 38-byte area, builds a two-byte packet with a fixed type code and fixed value, and sends it through another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10FA6
name: send_packet_with_two_bytes
description: Builds a four-byte packet from a fixed type code, a fixed length code and two bytes read from offsets within the argument, and passes it to another routine for sending.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:10FEA
name: send_constant_command
description: Places two constant bytes on the stack and passes a pointer to them to another routine for sending.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1101E
name: send_ack_and_clear_flag
description: Sends the first acknowledgement code through a library call and clears the error state flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:11040
name: fill_buffer_with_count
description: Writes a sequence of bytes to a buffer, each one the low byte of a counter that counts down from the requested count to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:11054
name: generate_random_word_masked
description: Adds a constant to a value from a library call, stores the sum in a global, and returns its upper sixteen bits masked to fifteen bits.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:11088
name: store_high_word_global
description: Stores the high sixteen bits of its argument in a global variable.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1109A
name: convert_to_uppercase
description: Returns its byte argument converted to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter, and unchanged otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:110B2
name: convert_to_lowercase
description: Returns its byte argument converted to lowercase when it is an uppercase letter, and unchanged otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:110CA
name: open_dos_library_or_alert
description: Clears a large block of memory, saves the exec base, opens the dos library through the exec open-library call, and calls the exec alert routine when opening fails, otherwise running another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:1113C
name: stub_no_operation
description: Empty routine that only returns; it has no effect.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:11144

name: build_lock_list

name: pass_params_to_subroutine

name: format_text_and_output

name: boot_setup_find_resident
